notes.title: Smol Update
notes.content:

notes.title: Language Update!

This was made possible by very dedicated members of our community, so thank you all for helping us by contributing your time and effort!!

Enjoy the game, have a great day and stay safe!

MEOW =^_^=

notes.title: Small update to fix a few things
notes.content:
Hello cat lovers,

with this update we want to address:
- Korean localization
- CPU
- corrupted savegames

[b]Korean localization[/b]:
The errors pointed out by the community should now (hopefully) be fixed!
A huge thanks to [b]zeramise[/b] and [b]undefined[/b] who helped troubleshooting and worked on the translation sheet!

[b]CPU[/b]:
Cats Organized Neatly should now consume less CPU

[b]Corrupted savegames[/b]:
A few users have pointed out that their game progress was reset several times. Unfortunately this is very hard for us to reproduce. We did some changes to the way the game is saved and hope this might prevent this from happening again.

That's it for now - thanks for sticking with us!
In case you want to help with the translations or even add your own language, check out [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1scC5XGPo4nUJQVaLNajT68Qxv5i9GxcLkcOizyu-UfU/edit#gid=0]this sheet[/url]! :)

notes.title: Update number three and more fixes :D
notes.content:
Hey Cat organizers!

This is our third game update to adress a couple of the bugs and feature requests.

Thank you so much for reporting bugs and being active on the forums!

Thank you all for being patient and reporting these bugs :)

notes.title: Hotfix regarding achievements not working properly
notes.content:
Hello cat organizers!

Thank you for providing us with all the valuable feedback.

With this hotfix we want to adress the following:

[list]
[*] Achievements should now unlock for each completed chapter with no levels skipped in it. (e.g. you've played level 1 to 10 you should get the achievement for chapter one, but not if you skipped a level in between)
[*] F12 Steam Screenshots should now work
[*] For non 16:9 monitors the game will start in windowed mode, so that the cursor isn't offset. If you use the in-game option to change the game from windowed to fullscreen and back, the game should remember your setting
[/list]

A known issue is, that the social media buttons do not link to the correct websites for some users. We still couldn't figure out why that is, sorry!

Thanks everyone for using the Steam forums and reporting bugs and issues, we really appreciate it.
